MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "PTXmas and That's Christmas To Me feel like natural next choices because they combine Christmas songs with the vocal arrangements I want to hear.",
    "These two choices connect my earlier Christmas album listening with my more recent interest in The New Old Fashioned."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Summer Horns and Amazing 50s Stereo Jukebox offer music, but their summer theme or broad oldies selection misses the Christmas vocal listening I am interested in now.",
    "Duets, pop albums and country retrospectives do not give me enough of the specific holiday connection to make me try them on a visit when I would choose only a few items.",
    "Stages, Passione and Harry Potter And The Goblet Of Fire do not suggest a clear enough connection to my recent albums for me to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat a general interest in albums as enough reason to offer music with very different themes.",
    "An apparent connection through singers or vocal performances feels too broad when the Christmas songs and particular vocal arrangements are what draw me in."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my earlier selections were Christmas albums, including two interactions with The Classic Christmas Album, so that repeated theme matters to my choices here.",
    "My latest selection, The New Old Fashioned, makes vocal group arrangements relevant alongside that holiday interest; either connection alone is less compelling than both together."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "A couple of choices understood my interest in Christmas vocal music, but most stretched that interest into music I have little reason to choose now."
}
